# Suggestions (chat block)

• Suggestions(prompt? (static), options (static))
  - Description: A follow-up question with replies the user can tap; a tap sends the `say` event.
  - prompt: The follow-up question shown above the replies.
  - options: Two to four short replies the user can tap.

Suggestions(prompt?, options) — a follow-up question and 2–4 short replies the user can tap, placed under a block in the same Column. A tap sends Event `say` with {text, onScreen}: `text` is the reply, `onScreen` the live values of every block on the surface (what the user dragged, unticked or reordered); answer from onScreen, not from what you first sent. Put the follow-up question here, not in your prose. Example: next = Suggestions("Want me to compare 20 years, or add inflation?", ["Make it 20 years", "Add inflation", "Save this plan"])
